description: The file defines the UsersService class, implementing user-related operations such as registration and authentication, interfacing with a repository and handling errors.

classes.name: UsersService
classes.description: Service class for user operations such as registration and authentication, encapsulating business logic and interactions with the user repository.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes UsersService with a database session and sets up the user repository.

methods.name: register(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user; raises ConflictError if email already exists, otherwise creates and returns the user.

methods.name: authenticate(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user; raises UnauthorizedError if credentials are invalid.

methods.name: get_user_by_id(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves user details by user ID.

ctags.name: authenticate
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate(self, email: str, password: str):$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^    def register(self, email: str, password: str):$/
